title: ShiftPV · Storage Overview
description: Operational overview, Pool comparison and scoped diagnostics. Unknown is distinct from healthy or zero. Read-only observations; no quota or application I/O claims.

list.name: freshness
list.label: Observation window
list.description: Dashboard-only freshness window. Set above the configured Pool probe interval; this does not alter storage admission.

panels.title: Collection
panels.description: Latest status of discovered ShiftPV targets. Healthy means all returned targets are up, not that an expected target inventory is complete. Pool filter does not apply.

targets.expr: min(up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Observations
panels.description: Latest success and age of returned snapshots, using the selected observation window. Healthy covers returned sources only, not a complete expected inventory. Check Collection and observation details. Pool filter does not apply.

targets.expr: min((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} * (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} > bool 0) * ((time() - shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) < bool ${freshness})) * on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) group_left () up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Active moves
panels.description: Current linked Moves except Succeeded, including Blocked. Unknown if any returned metadata observer in the selected scope is unavailable or stale. Pool filter does not apply.

targets.expr: sum((shiftpv_moves{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",phase!="Succeeded"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))) and on () (min((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",source="metadata",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} * (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",source="metadata",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} > bool 0) * ((time() - shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",source="metadata",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) < bool ${freshness})) * on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) group_left () up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) == 1)

panels.title: Blocked volumes
panels.description: Current Blocked Volume CRs, not all deferred candidates. Unknown if any returned metadata observer in the selected scope is unavailable or stale. Pool filter does not apply.

targets.expr: sum((shiftpv_volumes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",phase="Blocked"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))) and on () (min((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",source="metadata",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} * (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",source="metadata",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} > bool 0) * ((time() - shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",source="metadata",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) < bool ${freshness})) * on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) group_left () up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) == 1)

panels.title: Pool capacity & reservations
panels.description: Current observations only. Unknown means unavailable, failed or older than the selected window. FS available includes other writers; Reserved and Limit are logical reservations, not actual file usage. No Volume CR may be a creation in progress; it is not an automatic deletion instruction.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pool, node) (((shiftpv_pool_ready{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))) or (shiftpv_pool_ready{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} * 0 - 1)), "column", "Ready", "pool", ".*")

label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pool, node) (((shiftpv_pool_accounting_valid{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))) or (shiftpv_pool_accounting_valid{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} * 0 - 1)), "column", "Accounting", "pool", ".*")

label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pool, node) ((shiftpv_pool_filesystem_available_bytes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="filesystem"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="filesystem"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))), "column", "FS available", "pool", ".*")

label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pool, node) ((shiftpv_pool_reserved_bytes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} and (shiftpv_pool_accounting_valid{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} == 1)) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))), "column", "Reserved", "pool", ".*")

label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pool, node) ((shiftpv_pool_capacity_limit_bytes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))), "column", "Limit", "pool", ".*")

label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pool, node) ((shiftpv_pool_unregistered_reserved_bytes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} and (shiftpv_pool_accounting_valid{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} == 1)) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))), "column", "No Volume CR", "pool", ".*")

panels.title: Filesystem available · %
panels.description: Space in the filesystem containing each Pool directory, shared with other writers. Gaps indicate unavailable/failed/stale observations. Series are not summed.

targets.expr: (100 * shiftpv_pool_filesystem_available_bytes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} / shiftpv_pool_filesystem_size_bytes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="filesystem"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="filesystem"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))

panels.title: Reservation limit used · %
panels.description: Logical reservations / configured limit. This is not filesystem utilization or a per-PVC write quota. Gaps indicate invalid accounting or stale metadata.

targets.expr: ((100 * shiftpv_pool_reserved_bytes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} / shiftpv_pool_capacity_limit_bytes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"}) and (shiftpv_pool_accounting_valid{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"} == 1)) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))

panels.title: Filesystem available inodes
panels.description: Current filesystem free inodes, observed by the existing probe. Gaps indicate unavailable/failed/stale observations.

targets.expr: (shiftpv_pool_filesystem_available_inodes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pool=~"${pool:regex}"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="filesystem"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="filesystem"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))

panels.title: Mobility · installation-wide, independent of Pool filter
Current volume states
panels.description: Only non-zero phase counts from fresh metadata. An empty table can mean no volumes or unavailable observations; the overview distinguishes observation health.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, phase) ((shiftpv_volumes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="metadata"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))) > 0

panels.title: Current movement deferrals
panels.description: Only non-zero deferral counts from fresh discovery. An empty table can mean no deferrals or unavailable discovery; inspect observation status. Reasons are diagnosis hints, not individual Volume identities.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, reason) ((shiftpv_mobility_deferred_volumes{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) ((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="discovery"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",source="discovery"} > time() - ${freshness}) and on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) (up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} == 1))) > 0

panels.title: CSI diagnostics · installation-wide, independent of Pool filter
Completed RPCs · /s
panels.description: Lifecycle calls only; retries included. No series before first calls. This is not application I/O throughput.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, method, code) (rate(shiftpv_csi_requests_total{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Non-OK RPCs · /s
panels.description: Non-OK includes expected rejections and retries. No series can mean no recorded non-OK calls or unavailable collection; inspect overview.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, method, code) (rate(shiftpv_csi_requests_total{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",code!="OK"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: RPC processing time · p95
panels.description: Server RPC duration, not transfer duration, disk latency or end-to-end Pod startup. No calls means no percentile.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, le, method) (rate(shiftpv_csi_request_duration_seconds_bucket{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Snapshot result & age
panels.description: State: Healthy only when the latest observation succeeded, its timestamp is positive, it is within the selected window and its scrape target is up. Missing values stay Unknown. No successful observation means no age value.

targets.expr: label_replace((shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_success{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} * (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} > bool 0) * ((time() - shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) < bool ${freshness})) * on (cluster, namespace, job, instance) group_left () up{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}, "column", "State", "source", ".*")
label_replace(time() - (shiftpv_metrics_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{shiftpv="true",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} > 0), "column", "Age", "source", ".*")
